//: Firestore indexes. Deployed alongside the rules by the GitHub workflow.
//account-js: api/account.js deleteAccount runs db.collectionGroup('members').where('uid','==',uid). A collection-group query ALWAYS needs an explicit index - Firestore cannot serve one without it, and the call fails with 9 FAILED_PRECONDITION (instantly, not on a timeout). This index is what makes account deletion work at all.
